# Sanctuary × 4Seas

> Curated longevity-focused founder residency. Hosted by Andrej Berlin. Chiang Mai, Thailand, 30 November–29 December 2026. Check-in 29 November.

Sanctuary curates longevity enthusiasts with an existing experiment, question or project at the intersection of AI, longevity practices and human life. Expert mentorship, peer collaboration and funding opportunities.

Cost: $2,999 USD for the month or $999 USD for a listed week. Weekly dates: 29 November–6 December, 6–13 December, 13–20 December, 20–27 December 2026. Package inclusions differ; see the website protocol.

Accommodation: 4seas Mountain View, 81 Moo 1 BaanPong HangDong Chiang Mai 50230, Thailand. Tests and scans at partner facilities.

Programme: https://get.4seas.xyz/
Apply through the website.
